svg.text: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding
Representation → Selection → Reuse: A Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories

g.text: cd repo → grep → edit → test fail → revert → edit → test...
find . → cat file → patch → error → retry → timeout...
locate file → hypothesis → fix → tests pass ✓
explore → wrong path → partial fix → regression...
Hard to compare or reuse directly
read summary → direct fix → test pass ✓
Avoid known dead ends, reuse insights
Core Insight: Test-time scaling for agents = Representation + Selection + Reuse
